issuing_orgs: National Institute of Diabetes and Digestive and Kidney Diseases
synopsis: This Notice of Funding Opportunity (NOFO) seeks to stimulate HIV/AIDS research within the mission of the National Institute of Diabetes and Digestive and Kidney Diseases (NIDDK) that align with the HIV/AIDS research priorities outlined by the NIH Office of AIDS Research (OAR). These priorities were most recently described in NOT-OD-20-018 UPDATE: NIH HIV/AIDS Research Priorities and Guidelines for Determining HIV/AIDS Funding.
title: Priority HIV/AIDS Research within the Mission of NIDDK (R01 Clinical Trial Optional)
